purpose: Additional research candidates from Amazon 12-hour sleep sound podcast, myNoise catalog and uploaded Ahrefs CSV. Spotify White Noise 10 Hours playlist confirmed but track listing inaccessible; do not attribute item-level track names.
policy: Research proposals only; do not alter catalog/library.json, family registry counts, published pages, sitemap, media routes, or 45 presets. Some proposed items are mixes not independent audio. Before activation require deduplication against NEW-01..NEW-70, provenance/license, unique independent source duration, acoustic QA and owner's listening approval. No copyrighted streaming audio copying.
